overview: Medford High School students present episode 17 of the Mustang Report, featuring talent show announcements, player introductions for the girls hockey team, and student musical performances.

items.title: Talent Show Announcement
items.summary: Victoria Rasche hosts a comedic talent segment promoting the upcoming Medford High School Talent Show.

items.title: Girls Hockey Player Introductions
items.summary: Members of the girls hockey team are announced individually during player introductions.

items.title: Question of the Week and Musical Performances
items.summary: Students highlight special talents and present vocal performances of the songs Glory and We're All in This Together.
